title: fp_medium u16-lane BLIS MC/KC restructure (74ba1cdc Phase 6b)
description:
Phase 6b follow-up under epic `026fc832`. 74ba1cdc R1 closed GF(251)/n=4096 to PASS (ratio 1.458) but GF(65521)/n=4096 remained SHORTFALL at ratio 1.753. The R1 worker tried MR=3 and MR=4 register-tile variants on the new fp_medium panel kernel but both regressed (-21% and -35%) due to register spills.

## Amendment (2026-05-26, user-approved, session 9)

695350fd R0 (commits `0de86fd9..191a69c8`) landed a +1.2% improvement (40.25 Gop/s, ratio 1.732) on GF(65521)/n=4096 via BLIS NC outer cache blocking + MR-interleaved A-pack scratch. R0 worker's µop analysis found the AVX2 u16-mulhi-mullo MAC path is **arithmetic-bound at ~40 Gop/s** (kernel achieves 106% of estimated shuffle-pipe ceiling). fflas's 69.72 Gop/s matches Zen-3 f64 FMA peak (70 GFLOP/s) → fflas likely uses an f64 GEMM cascade.

**User chose: file Phase 6e `0749dbad`** ("f64 GEMM cascade for fp_medium") as the architectural follow-up. The u16 path improvement is bounded by the AVX2 arithmetic ceiling; further work requires a new f64 cascade kernel analogous to Route A's f32 path.

**Amended SC#1 reads:** "GF(65521) at n=4096 PASS via follow-up `0749dbad`. Within 695350fd, the +1.2% improvement is documented (40.25 Gop/s vs 39.78 baseline, ratio 1.753 → 1.732); full closure deferred to `0749dbad`."

**Amended SC#7 reads:** "98336ab4's full-PASS re-bench depends on `0749dbad` landing (not `695350fd` alone). DAG re-wired: `98336ab4` now depends on `0749dbad` instead of `695350fd`."

Original SC#1 + SC#7 preserved in the **Original Success Criteria** subsection below for audit. All other SCs remain `[hard]` and are verified for 695350fd closure.

## Background

R1 fp_medium changes (`crates/gf2-kernels-simd/src/x86/fp_medium.rs`, new in commit `ba4a10e9`):
- Introduced `fp_medium_gemm_panel` with MR=2, NR=16 (chosen to fit 16 AVX2 ymm registers without spills).
- Brought GF(65521)/n=4096 from 36.34 to 39.78 Gop/s (+9.5%).
- Ratio improved from 1.92 to 1.753; PASS threshold is 1.5 → gap +17%.

The MR=2, NR=16 tile is register-pressure-limited.

## Scope (R0 — implemented)

Restructure `fp_medium_gemm_panel` with BLIS-style 3-level cache blocking + tuned register tile. Keep MR=2 (MR=3/4 register-spill regressions confirmed).

- [hard] No regression on existing PASS cells at n ∈ {64, 256, 1024} for all 6 primes (delta ≤ 5%).
- [hard] Bit-exact correctness preserved (proptest sweep at boundary lengths {0, 1, 15, 16, 17, 63, 64, 65} for all 6 primes).

- [hard] After this task lands, 98336ab4 worker re-benches all n=4096 cells; 98336ab4 closes PASS for all 6 cells.
